description: Authenticated online evaluation against the live deployment. Drives the running Agent with real per-user OAuth identities to measure live model tool selection, ERPNext data handling, OAuth permission boundaries and end-to-end draft HITL flows. Draft documents created by approved cases are deleted afterwards via a test-only REST cleanup path. Requires EVAL_ONLINE_* environment variables and two users who have logged in via browser OAuth.
